$comment: Where stadium photographs are shown and which derived file serves each place. Box aspect ranges (width / height) were MEASURED on the approved UI at base 6206a7e (Chromium, 375-1920 px viewports); widen them if the layout changes.

files: the derivatives made from every photograph. desktop keeps the whole frame; mobile is a 3:4 crop of the SAME photograph (full height, positioned by crop.mobile_focus); card is the 720x480 strip source.

targets.keep_min: the share of the photo's crop.keep rectangle (its identifying architecture) that must stay visible across the whole aspect range for a photo approved under standard 2. Legacy (standard 1) photos are measured and reported, not blocked.

targets.where: Game hero, viewport >= 720 px: 1.26 at 768, 4.3 at 1280, 4.9 at 1440, 6.2 at 1920 (a 234-253 px tall band)
Game hero, viewport < 720 px: 0.61-0.78 on 375-430 px phones
Home / sport-home featured card, viewport >= 720 px: 1.42 at 768, 2.3 at 1280, 3.3 at 1920
Week game tile strip, 118 px tall: 2.4-3.4
